title: A quadratic refinement of Jackson's \CE\ condition for Hamilton cycles in digraphs
summary: For a digraph $D$, let $α_2(D)$ be the largest size of a vertex set no two of whose vertices lie in a common directed $2$-cycle. Let $f_2(a)$ be the least integer $K$ such that every $K$-connected digraph $D$ with $α_2(D)\le a$ has a Hamilton cycle. Jackson proved in 1987 that $f_2(a)\le2^a(a+2)!$, whereas a conjecture of Jackson and Ordaz predicts $f_2(a)\le a+1$. We prove the quadratic bound $f_2(a)\le12000a^2$. We also prove that $κ(H)\ge6000(α(H)+r)$ guarantees vertex-disjoint paths joining any prescribed $r$ pairs of distinct vertices and covering $V(H)$.
